approval: Approved by Ben for password-locked private stakeholder demo on 2026-07-20.

records.title: Calm
records.suitable_citizen_state: Stress, fatigue, sensory overload, anxiety, recovery, quiet work and a need for spacious regulation.
records.not_suitable_citizen_state: Citizens explicitly seeking high activation, cathartic movement or festival-scale social energy.
records.editorial_notes: Existing Universal Mind live radio source. The station acts as the lowest-density radio stage gate. Station-level values describe the continuous channel rather than every individual song.

records.title: Chill
records.suitable_citizen_state: Balanced reflection, warm recovery, coastal openness, shared calm, gentle work and stable presence.
records.not_suitable_citizen_state: States requiring either near-silence or strong motivational activation.
records.editorial_notes: Existing Universal Mind default radio continuation. Station-level values describe the continuous channel rather than every individual song.

records.title: House
records.suitable_citizen_state: Joy, agency, movement, social connection, confidence and readiness for positive activation.
records.not_suitable_citizen_state: Acute sensory overload, high startle sensitivity, sleep onset or a stated need for quiet focus.
records.editorial_notes: Existing Universal Mind activation radio source. Station-level values describe the continuous channel rather than every individual song.

records.title: Groove Salad
records.suitable_citizen_state: Work, sustained attention, creative flow, gentle recovery, reduced mental clutter and unobtrusive rhythmic movement.
records.not_suitable_citizen_state: Citizens asking for vocal affirmation, strong social activation or very low-stimulation sleep support.
records.editorial_notes: Ambient and downtempo groove channel integrated for the private stakeholder demo. Station-level values describe the continuous channel rather than every individual song.

records.title: Groove Salad Classic
records.suitable_citizen_state: Warm nostalgia, belonging, familiar chillout culture, reflective work, recovery and reconnection with positive memory.
records.not_suitable_citizen_state: Citizens who find nostalgia ruminative or who explicitly need novel, high-energy material.
records.editorial_notes: Classic early downtempo channel integrated for the private stakeholder demo. Station-level values describe the continuous channel rather than every individual song.

records.title: Dark Electro
records.suitable_citizen_state: Anger moving toward agency, fierce identity, emotional numbing, curiosity, cathartic embodiment and readiness for darker electronic intensity.
records.not_suitable_citizen_state: Acute hypervigilance, high startle sensitivity, sensory overload, sleep pressure or a stated need for calm.
records.editorial_notes: Dark Electro, Industrial, EBM, Synthpop and Goth channel integrated for the private stakeholder demo. Edge is treated as a route into power and identity, not pathologised.

records.title: Retro
records.suitable_citizen_state: Belonging, shared cultural memory, identity affirmation, joy, connection and the warmth of familiar New Wave and alternative 80s music.
records.not_suitable_citizen_state: Citizens who find era-linked nostalgia painful or who require sparse, non-vocal focus music.
records.editorial_notes: New Wave and alternative 80s channel integrated for the private stakeholder demo. Station-level values describe the continuous channel rather than every individual song.
